caption_candidates.text: Figure 1. Illustration depicts the three acromial shapes: flat (type 1), smoothly curved (type 2), and hooked (type 3). A = anterior, P = posterior.
Figure 2. Sagittal oblique MR image (2,000/40) in a 30-year-old man demonstrates a flat (type 1) acromion. A = anterior.
Figure 3. Sagittal oblique MR image (2,000/40) in a 29-year-old man demonstrates a smoothly curved (type 2) acromion. A = anterior.
Figure 4. Sagittal oblique MR image (2,000/40) in a 58-year-old woman demonstrates a hooked (type 3) acromion. A = anterior.
